message.content:
# Senior Review — Slot Picker Sheet (390px)

## 1) Available vs. past state — **instantly readable? NO**
This is the core failure. Every time pill (09:00 → 16:45) uses the **identical light-gray fill and identical text color**. There is no filled/selected state, no strikethrough or reduced-opacity past state, no "booked" state, and no outline style. A user cannot tell which slots are bookable without tapping blindly. A slot picker where states are indistinguishable is functionally broken.

Related: the "Confirm slot" button is gray — presumably disabled — but since no pill ever looks selected, the user has no model of *why* it's disabled. The state loop (select → enable confirm) has no visible starting point.

## 2) Grid rhythm / alignment
- 4-column rhythm is consistent and gutters look even — this part is competent.
- But every row is fully populated (4 slots), which combined with defect #1 makes the grid read as a static table, not an interactive picker.
- Section labels MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING are fine in hierarchy but there's no divider or spacing change; sections blend into the grid.

## 3) Touch targets
- Pills are ~44px wide but roughly **~30–32px tall** — below the 44×44 minimum. Vertical hit area is too tight for a dense grid where adjacent rows are only a few px apart.
- Date chips are slightly taller but the trailing chip is clipped to near-zero width (see #5), making it an accidental tap hazard.

## 4) Sheet affordances
- Grab handle is present but rendered as a barely-visible gray dash on white — near-zero contrast; fails as an affordance.
- **No close (✕) affordance at all.** No way to dismiss/recover if the user changed their mind about this doctor. The dimmed background is the only exit.
- No title for the sheet ("Select a time") — it relies on context alone.

## 5) Clipping / unfinished look
- **Fourth date chip ("11/...") is clipped mid-glyph** at the right edge — looks broken, and the horizontal scroll affordance is invisible (no partial peek padding, no fade).
- Footer line "₹300 · pay at the clinic" appears to be **cut by the fixed confirm bar** — descenders/next line clipped; the sticky bar isn't accounting for content above it.
- Selected chip is "11/23" while the first chip says "Today" — if 11/23 is today, the duplication is confusing; if not, no date label communicates which day 11/23 is (no weekday).
- Doctor header (avatar, name, credentials) is **duplicated verbatim** in the sheet ("Rajesh · General Physician · ₹300 consult") — redundant, wasteful vertical space, and reads as unfinished.
- "limit 50" in the summary line is unexplained jargon; "0 booked today" contradicts "32 slots open" without clarification.

## Minor
- Header title is literally "Doctor" — placeholder-like.
- Back button and title styling in the dimmed region is fine but irrelevant once the sheet is open (should be visually suppressed, not competing).

---

## Verdict: **FAIL**

Blocking issues: (1) available/past/selected states are not visually differentiated — the picker's core function is unreadable; (2) clipped date chip; (3) footer clipped under the confirm bar; (4) sub-44px touch targets across the entire grid; (5) no close affordance. Fix state styling, target heights, and the edge/footer clipping before re-review.
message.reasoning_content: Review strictly. Defects: available vs disabled indistinguishable — all pills same gray; no clearly past slots shown disabled; confirm button grayed (disabled?) but hard to tell. Date chips: "Tomorrow" seems muted/disabled? Edge chip "11..." clipped. No close button, handle present but low contrast. Footer "₹300 · pay at the clinic" clipped by confirm bar? Row shows "32 slots open · 0 booked today · limit 50" — limit 50 confusing. Selected date 11/23 but "Today" — mismatch? Confirm button gray disabled state. Last date chip clipped at edge. Time pills small touch height ~ maybe fine but width fine. "pay at the clinic" row appears cut at sheet edge.
